name: Pirates of the Caribbean: At World's End

locations.note: Jack escapes the Fortress Prison and goes to Port Royal to find Tia Dalma, and returns there at the end.
The crew visits the real Caribbean island of Tortuga on the way to the Pirate Lords.
Will makes a pact with Sao Feng in Singapore, and British forces attack the city.

routes.name: Jack Sparrow
routes.note: From Port Royal through Tortuga to Singapore and back.
